Total RNA was extracted from Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells with the RNeasy minikit (Qiagen™), according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were synthesize with the Illumina’s TruSeq Stranded mRNA Sample Prep Kit v2 using 500 nanogram of total RNA following manufacturer’s protocol.
attributes: HIV infectious disease and hepatitis C virus infection
